content: Yes, it is true that in Switzerland, all persons aged 18 or older are required to pay AHV (Alters- und Hinterlassenenversicherung, or Old-Age and Survivors Insurance) contributions, regardless of whether they are working or not. This applies to both residents and non-residents who are subject to Swiss social security contributions. The contributions are based on income, but the obligation to pay them exists irrespective of employment status.
